name: i3 Keypad
description: An in-wall dimmer with four buttons, each with an LED. Button 1, at the top, controls the load by default; the others control nothing until linked, and any of them can be set to control the load.
notes: It replies 0x02 to Get Insteon Engine Version (cmd1 0x0D), as i2CS devices do, and broadcasts Button Held (cmd1 0x01), with its hardware version in cmd2, when any button is held, even with programming locked.
